about_the_game:
Chroma Blasters is a solo developed top-down twin-stick arcade shooter where enemy waves are shaped by sound. With over 120 music tracks and a fast, reactive color-matching gameplay, every track becomes a new battlefield.

You control a turret locked at the center of the screen. One stick per gun barrel. Two colors per side. Switch colors on the fly by holding either bumpers or triggers.

Enemies spawn based on the music tracks highs, mids, and lows, surrounding your central turret in an evolving spiral of pressure. To survive the onslaught match your shots to the incoming enemies before they can reach and destroy you.

Score is everything. Color-matched shots earn the greatest points and one-hit kills. Mismatched shots require multiple hits and score less. Taking out enemies at greater distance, the more bonus points awarded for the kill. Your shield can save you once, but enemies it kills when destroyed won’t count to your score.

  • Defend your position.

  • Switch colors fast.

  • Prioritize threats.

  • Survive and score high.


  • Over 120 sound-driven levels - Every track is a new challenge

  • 5 genre styles (Electronic, Rock, Synth, Metal, Vocal)

  • Built for precision with responsive twin-stick controls (Steam Deck ready)

  • Color-matching & distance based scoring that rewards mastery

  • Achievements & per-track high scores to chase

short_description: Blast your way through 120+ dynamic music-driven levels in this twin-stick arcade shooter. Defend against waves of color-coded enemies that spawn to the beat and use tight reflexes and precision color-matching to score big against the chaotic audio-fueled spirals.
